description: This file defines the Binomial class with methods for calculating binomial distribution probabilities, binomial range, negative binomial distribution, and inverse binomial calculations, specifically for statistical distributions in spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Binomial
classes.description: A class providing methods for binomial and negative binomial distribution calculations, including probability mass functions, cumulative distribution functions, and inverse calculations.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the binomial distribution probability or cumulative probability based on input parameters.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Calculates the probability for a range of successes in binomial distribution.

methods.name: negative
methods.description: Calculates the negative binomial distribution probability.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the smallest number of successes for which the cumulative binomial distribution exceeds a given threshold.

methods.name: calculateCumulativeBinomial
methods.description: Helper method to compute cumulative binomial probability for a given number of successes.
